instruction: Candid full-body documentary photograph inside a subway station near the exit turnstiles. The blonde woman in a striped crop top and jeans (R1) walks on the left, smiling up at her partner. Beside her, the bearded man in a blue long-sleeve shirt and khaki shorts (R2) walks forward, looking back at her with a smile. His left arm rests over her shoulder while they hold hands at waist level. The scene is lit by warm overhead lights, creating a soft, casual atmosphere on the tiled floor.
